title: Correcting a library newsletter

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: For our library newsletter, check the interview transcript before changing a number in an article. Yesterday’s draft said our book cart serves twenty-six households. The librarian said seventeen. Fix that number in the draft now. The caption below the photograph gives the number of books on the cart, not households. Leave that figure alone. If our already published web article has the same mistake, add a correction below it. Don’t just replace the number without telling readers what changed.
turns.zh: 編輯圖書館電子報時，修改文章中的數字前，先查訪談逐字稿。昨天的草稿寫行動書車服務二十六戶，但圖書館員說的是十七戶。現在請更正草稿中的這個數字。照片下方的圖說寫的是書車上的書籍數，不是戶數，那個數字不用改。如果已發布的網頁文章也有同樣錯誤，請在下方加一則更正說明，不要直接換掉數字卻不告訴讀者改了什麼。
